title: Episodic positive selection structurally stabilizes the Arabidopsis CONSTANS-like gene COL5 indicating adaptive evolution.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥COL5转录因子在适应性进化中的结构稳定化，通过祖先序列重建、Rosetta能量计算和MD模拟揭示正选择对蛋白构象动态的影响，虽非TF-DNA结合机制本身，但MD与结构稳定性方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: The CONSTANS-like (COL) transcription factors integrate photoperiod cues with developmental regulation in plants, yet the evolutionary forces shaping their structural diversity remain poorly understood. Here, the evolutionary history of COL5 was reconstructed across 31 Brassicaceae genomes using a curated set of 284 high-confidence orthologs validated for domain architecture, alignment quality, and absence of substitution saturation. Branch-specific codon models identified a single episodically selected lineage within Arabidopsis thaliana, and site-level analyses mapped two non-synonymous amino-acid replacements uniquely acquired along this branch. Ancestral sequence reconstruction recovered the historical residues at both positions with posterior probability 1.0, enabling controlled reverse-evolution mutagenesis. Reintroduction of these ancestral states into the modern COL5 protein revealed a profound biophysical impact, Rosetta DeltaDeltaG values indicated strong destabilization, and 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations showed large increases in structural deviation, compaction, loss of flexibility, and significantly elevated potential energy. These results demonstrate that the derived residues stabilize the contemporary COL5 fold, whereas the ancestral residues are incompatible with the evolved structural background. The findings provide direct mechanistic evidence that episodic positive selection on COL5 produced a lasting shift in protein stability and conformational dynamics, illustrating how adaptive molecular evolution can reshape protein energy landscapes and entrench derived states through historical contingency.
abstract_zh: CONSTANS-like (COL) 转录因子在植物中整合光周期信号与发育调控，然而塑造其结构多样性的进化力量仍知之甚少。本研究利用一套经过域架构、比对质量和替代饱和缺失验证的284个高置信度直系同源基因，重建了COL5在31个十字花科 (Brassicaceae) 基因组中的进化历史。分支特异性密码子模型在拟南芥 (Arabidopsis thaliana) 中鉴定出一个经历单次 episodic 选择的分支，位点水平分析定位了该分支上独特获得的两个非同义氨基酸替换。祖先序列重建以1.0的后验概率恢复了这两个位点的历史残基，从而实现了受控的逆向进化诱变。将这些祖先状态重新引入现代COL5蛋白后，揭示了深刻的生物物理影响：Rosetta DeltaDeltaG 值表明强烈的不稳定化，100纳秒分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟显示结构偏差、压缩性大幅增加，灵活性丧失，且势能显著升高。这些结果表明，衍生残基稳定了当代COL5折叠，而祖先残基与进化后的结构背景不相容。研究结果提供了直接机制证据，表明COL5上的 episodic 正选择产生了蛋白质稳定性和构象动力学的持久转变，阐明了适应性分子进化如何重塑蛋白质能量景观并通过历史偶然性固化衍生状态。
